frozen_target.question: On the exact Round-195 open packets, can the complete physical P_boundary(lit) dotcup P_sf dotcup P_gf complement be written as one coefficient-preserving twisted cellular boundary on the four cross-gcd allocation states, so that the aligned literal face, sign failure and changed-gcd failure cancel before positivity and yield the joint outer O(L^2 X^epsilon) bound; or does this specified mechanism have a first exact self-return?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For W=chi_4(d')chi_4(d)Phi_{r,sigma}(N)lambda_{N+r,sigma}(d')conj(lambda_{N,sigma}(d)), N=dm, N+r=d'm', g=(d,d'), d=g alpha, d'=g beta and P2=1_(|d-gm|<=D_L)1_(|d'-gm'|>D_L), define G00=(d,d'), G10=(m,d'), G01=(d,m'), G11=(m,m'). Test an exact physical two-chain C with actual chi_4 incidence satisfying partial_(chi,lit) C=(P_boundary(lit)+P_sf+P_gf)W+E_safe. The theorem exit is |R_open,out^sigma((P_boundary(lit)+P_sf+P_gf)W)|<<L^2X^epsilon on kappa<D_L, min(Y,D_L)>H_B mathfrak m kappa. The aligned face is tested first; an exact mechanism self-return closes the round with no analytic pivot.
quantities: The exact complement is P_boundary(lit)=P2 1_((m,beta)=1)1_(chi_4(alpha m)=-1)(1-C_lit), P_sf=P2 1_((m,beta)=1)1_(chi_4(alpha m)!=-1), and P_gf=P2 1_((m,beta)>1).
Squarefreeness makes G00,G10,G01,G11 pairwise coprime with product gcd(N,N+r); G00=g and G10=(m,beta), so the three pieces are the ordered gcd/sign/code failure filtration of the accepted lower edge.
Every cell must preserve N and N+r, be bijective on its live physical domain, display every recomputed gcd and inverse cell, and use the actual quotient of chi_4(d)chi_4(d') as its incidence sign.

The aligned identity ((g alpha/m)-g)((g m/alpha)-g)=-g^2(alpha-m)^2/(alpha m) permits all close pairs to cross a sharp ratio face; a surviving ordinary face has D_L L^2 capacity against the L^2 target.
The cross-coprime four-corner rectangle forces physical kappa=1 and its simultaneous swap has sign +1; it cannot stand in for a complete cross-gcd cell on every 2<=kappa<D_L packet.
The fixed-packet positive bound u(kappa+min(Y,D_L))X^epsilon misses the sufficient H_B mathfrak m kappa uX^epsilon scale throughout the open region.

The physical chain precedes Fourier and height operations. Restore both orientations, both T branches, all endpoint factors, phases, carries, selectors, transported-mask commutators, births/deaths and zero extensions before one outer real part.
A face-only or other strict-submask theorem is subordinate evidence, not the Round-199 theorem exit. A no-go is mechanism-scoped and proves no literal lower bound.
